page.title: Trip operations
page.subtitle: The four stages a trip goes through on the platform — nudge the right person when a stage stalls.

urgent.pickup_soon: {count, plural, one {# pickup overdue} other {# pickups overdue}}
urgent.active: {count, plural, one {# return overdue} other {# returns overdue}}

intro.pending_approval: Hosts have 60 minutes to answer; the system already reminded them at minute 20 and 45. Under 15 minutes left with no answer: call them or send a nudge — the customer is waiting to look elsewhere.
intro.awaiting_hold: The host accepted and the vehicle is held for the customer. They have 120 minutes to pay the hold; the system reminds them at 60 and 15 minutes left. When time runs out the vehicle returns to the marketplace by itself.
intro.pickup_soon: Paid bookings picking up within the next 24 hours. Past the pickup time with no handover: ask the shop — the customer may be standing there.
intro.active: Vehicles currently with customers. Past the return time with no return handover: ask the shop; settlement only runs after the return record.

empty.pending_approval: No request is waiting for a host right now.
empty.awaiting_hold: No request is waiting for a customer's hold.
empty.pickup_soon: No pickup in the next 24 hours.
